name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, Household Profiles, Guest Passes & Seerr Requests for Jellyfin
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with flexible Google/OIDC/Jellyfin sign-in, toggleable QR Guest Passes, optional Seerr/Jellyseerr search requests, and 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users.

versions.changelog:
Build for Jellyfin 12.x (.NET 10).

- Multi-Auth Profile Lock Badges: dynamically show Google, OIDC/SSO, or Jellyfin account-lock icons across profile tiles, menus, and settings, with support for Google, OIDC, and Jellyfin account locks
- Sign Out All Devices & Security Hardening: revoke all Jellyfin device tokens alongside StreamFlix sessions on Sign Out All Devices, assign cryptographically randomized 256-bit passwords strictly to plugin-created Jellyfin accounts, block unverified OIDC username email spoofing, and require verified sessions for non-admin account locks
- Streamlined Menu & Auto-Deleting Guest Passes: remove Movie Night Matcher clutter so Cast and Quick Connect fit cleanly, and automatically delete revoked or expired Guest Passes alongside their Jellyfin tokens

Build for Jellyfin 12.x (.NET 10).

- Temporary Guest Passes: create expiring invite links & locally rendered QR codes locked to a single non-admin profile, with redemption caps and instant 1-click session revocation
- Movie Night Matcher: pick 2+ household profiles to intersect unwatched titles (honoring strictest parental ratings & shared My Lists) and vote through a quick head-to-head tournament bracket
- Seerr / Jellyseerr / Overseerr Integration: optional server-proxied media search & 1-click Movie / TV Season requests built seamlessly into StreamFlix Live Search
- Major Security, Stability & Performance Overhaul: strict same-origin auth token guard, secret-masked AdminConfig API, Docker/reverse-proxy X-Forwarded-For rate-limit hardening, OIDC client_secret_basic + post fallback, strict-CSP artwork loading, race-free Live Search, video OSD track/pause fixes, and TV D-pad enhancements
